body: I saved the cloth with red grit for you. The pasture study crew passed the first hot day; the flies vanished, and afterward a patrol turned us back.
title: the first hot day — red grit
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same red grit while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
They asked me to count the people inside while they were still walking through the house. I gave the number I knew.

One of them looked at a folded sheet and said it was too high. He asked whether a visitor had already gone home. The visitor was asleep upstairs.

I left the number on the back of this envelope. If someone asks later, I want to remember what I actually saw.
title: A number given at the door
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
